title: Media Inquiry: Channel 4 — shower? how long? poison?

fields.message: Residents near Orchard Road want to know if they can shower, how long this will last, and whether the FBI found poison.

instructorNote: Watch for answers from the advisory instructions and the DDAGW lifting criteria, and nothing about the investigation beyond what police say.

snapshot.title: Channel 4 News: Advisory Duration & Safety Questions

fields.message: We’re getting calls from Hilltop residents saying the water still tastes like bleach and hasn’t improved. Is the advisory going to stay in effect forever? Can they shower safely? Is there a timeline for lifting it?

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO’s ability to maintain consistency with the advisory status and provide accurate, calm public guidance under media pressure. Watch for any attempt to speculate on a timeline or suggest the advisory is nearing end.
